---
title: "Homework 9"
---

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

ds <- iris

# Question 1: Continuous X, Continuous Y

cc1 <- ggplot(data = ds) +
  aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
print(cc1)

# Question 2: Discrete X, Continuous Y

colorschemebox <- c("green", "blue", "purple")
colorschemeline <- c("red", "orange", "yellow")
dc1 <- ggplot(data = ds) +
  aes(x = Species, y = Petal.Length) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = colorschemebox, color = colorschemeline)

dc1

# Question 3: Continuous X, Discrete Y
ds2 <- ds |>
    filter(ds$Species != "virginica") |>
    mutate("SpeciesBinary" = Species == "setosa") 

ds2$SpeciesBinary <- as.numeric(ds2$SpeciesBinary)

cd1 <- ggplot(data = ds2) +
    aes(x = Sepal.Length , y = SpeciesBinary) +
    geom_point() +
    stat_smooth(position = "jitter", method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"))

print(cd1)

# Question 4: Discrete X, Discrete Y
newds <- ds |>
    mutate(ds, newPetal = Petal.Length >= 4)
x_treatment <- newds$Species
y_outcome <- newds$newPetal
summary_data <- data.frame(x_treatment, y_outcome)

dd1 <- ggplot(data = summary_data) +
  aes(x = x_treatment) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = as.factor(y_outcome))) +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Number of samples with petal count over 4", fill = "True or False")

print(dd1)
```
